details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:2987-2990, 3040-3052, 3074-3087 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: GH_TOKEN is embedded in HTTPS Git URLs while per-process http.extraHeader authentication was removed.
  WHY: Tokens become visible in process arguments, Git errors, logs, and persisted remote.origin.url, reversing the credential-free URL contract.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:137-183, 569-604, 767, 883-919 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: _memory_git authentication was removed, bare Git operations lack authentication, and force-tick URLs embed GH_PAT/GH_TOKEN.
  WHY: Tokens leak through process arguments, errors, and remotes, while branch creation and memory Git operations fail in CI and silently disable memory writes.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:152-172, 240-247, 536-716 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path filtering and MAX_TARGET_PATHS/MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES bounds were deleted.
  WHY: Attacker-influenced paths can expose .git, .env, and credential files to model prompts, while targeted-context size guarantees are weakened.

- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:232-234, .github/workflows/plan.yml:294-296, .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml:359-361, .github/workflows/orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml:294-296 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: These workflows retain `.codex-workflow-src-main` mutable support-code fallbacks.
  WHY: If immutable support files are unavailable, mutable main scripts execute while GitHub, provider, and notification secrets are in scope; severity differs between reviewers, so the highest severity is used.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:after line 949 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: review_blocked_* helpers and git_with_github_auth were deleted while live callers remain.
  WHY: Review-blocked terminal actions, approval handling, successor deduplication, and authenticated Git pushes fail or silently skip; severity differs between reviewers, so the highest severity is used.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:732-769, 833-920 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: gh_pr_with_all_comments projections no longer include id, author_id, author_type, or author_association.
  WHY: Review-blocked and V2 producer-authentication consumers cannot identify trusted authors or validate approval/refusal state.

- scripts/review_conflict_actuate.sh:9-17 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The always-run actuator exits 1 when a failed resolver on a non-integration branch does not match `orchestrator/project-${INTEGRATION_TRACKING_NUM}`.
  WHY: Normal conflicted PR recovery reaches the actuator and fails instead of no-oping; severity differs between reviewers, so the highest severity is used.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:59-68 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The preservation guard restores only the worktree and mishandles staged modifications, staged deletions, and untracked `pre_assembled_static.txt`.
  WHY: A modified or deleted file can be committed, or the implementation can abort under `set -euo pipefail`.

- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py:30, 37, 714-781 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The test module imports deleted `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` and `is_sensitive_target_path`.
  WHY: Test collection fails with ImportError before the targeted-context tests run.

- tests/test_git_auth_hygiene.py:99-102, 111-178, 271-315, 339 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Existing hygiene tests still require deleted `_memory_git`, `git_with_github_auth`, and `review_blocked_*` identifiers and behavior.
  WHY: Assertions and subprocess calls fail, including tests enforcing credential-free Git URLs.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:552-620, 682-685 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The rewritten context loop removed non-string, OSError, and path-boundary guards.
  WHY: Malformed, missing, unreadable, or racing-deleted paths can abort prompt assembly instead of producing omission markers.

- scripts/codex_helpers.sh:174-180 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `MODEL_PROVIDER_BROKER_MAX_REQUESTS` defaults to 12.
  WHY: Normal multi-turn phases and resolver retries can exhaust the cap and fail with HTTP 429.

- scripts/model_provider_broker.py:76-78, 106 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `_authorized` calls `secrets.compare_digest` on missing or short Authorization values without guarding the input.
  WHY: Unauthenticated requests can raise ValueError and return an unintended 500 instead of 401; severity differs between reviewers, so the highest severity is used.

- scripts/model_provider_broker.py:161-167 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Responses exceeding 64 MiB are truncated after headers are sent without a client-visible truncation signal.
  WHY: Codex treats the close as a transport failure, retries, and can exhaust the broker request cap.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:536-620 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The rewritten output accounting no longer consistently bounds rendered headers, markers, fallback content, and summary bytes.
  WHY: Prompt output can exceed `TARGETED_FILE_CONTEXT_MAX_BYTES`; severity differs between reviewers, so the highest severity is used.

- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:308-311, 461-468 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `_resolver_restore_agent_access` is defined first as a no-op stub and later as the real ACL-restore implementation.
  WHY: Reviewers disagree whether Bash late binding makes this currently safe, but the duplicate definition is misleading and can cause ACL restoration failure if ordering changes; the highest severity is used.

- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:322-326 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The resolver exit trap no longer dispatches an immediate orchestrator poll when resolver exhaustion occurs without a candidate file.
  WHY: Common resolver failures wait for the five-minute cron tick instead of receiving immediate recovery.

- scripts/review_conflict_actuate.sh:70-77 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Force-tick dispatch requires `orchestrate_force_tick.sh` to be executable even though support staging does not set that mode.
  WHY: The immediate dispatch is skipped on real failure paths and recovery waits for the cron cadence.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5599-5675 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `extract_autofix_resolver_retry_state_from_comments` depends on `resolve_orchestrator_state_producer`, which is referenced but not defined in the PR diff.
  WHY: V2 retry-state extraction can silently return empty and never trust the signed producer envelope.

- scripts/review_conflict_actuate.sh:70-77 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The actuator passes environment-derived repository and issue values to `orchestrate_force_tick.sh` without a second consistency check.
  WHY: Mismatched workflow variables can trigger a force-tick for the wrong issue or repository.

- scripts/codex_helpers.sh:230-260, 318-336 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Unprivileged broker execution depends on NOPASSWD sudo and ACL/traverse access that may not exist for hosted runners or staged support directories.
  WHY: `sudo -n` or support-script access can fail on every model invocation.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:former extract_autofix_resolver_retry_state_from_pr_body | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The former `extract_autofix_resolver_retry_state_from_pr_body` identifier was replaced with a differently named and differently signed function.
  WHY: The internal caller was updated, but external consumers or tests using the old helper can receive command-not-found.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

  confidence=[5]

  confidence=[5]

  EVIDENCE: Four workflows retain `if [ ! -f "${src}" ] && [ -f ".codex-workflow-src-main/scripts/${f}" ]; then src=".codex-workflow-src-main/scripts/${f}"` fallbacks; matching `ref: main` checkout steps remain in the broader workflow set.

  confidence=[4]
